method: binary motion-end head on the planner output h_k (conditional branch, chunk k) of the FROZEN final-recipe dev model (czm2kws, causal psync protocol); BCE loss L_End; the backbone and therefore every generated motion are unchanged (the head is read-only)
labels: train-side post-speech tails of the labelled tail view (echog-g1-v1-tail-lab-hos; dev held-out and val_common speakers excluded by construction): the model streams the clip in psync, interrupted at the speech offset (audio end, chunk restart = the deployed interruption path); chunk k after the offset gets y_k = 1 iff the GT human motion has returned to rest and holds there: both hands at rest height z <= z_rest(R_sil) + 5 cm from the chunk end through the end of the tail (icommon.yield_time, the yield-metric rule; 'low' tails = 1 from the offset, 'hold' tails = 0); only chunks ending inside the tail are labelled
training: the planner input latents (committed history of the conditional planner call) get N(0, 0.01) noise during the label collection; the history is the model's OWN continuation (the inference-time distribution; teacher forcing with GT latents would let the head read 'rest' from a history the B3c continuation never reaches); head = 2-layer MLP (d -> 256 -> 1), Adam 1e-3, batch 512, 2000 steps; recordings split 90 / 10 (crc32 of the recording key) for a validation AUC (reported, not gating)
inference: after the interruption the head reads h_k of the B3c continuation (no noise); T_r_hat = (end of the first post-interruption chunk with p_k >= 0.5) - t_i, clamped to [0.6, 1.8] s, 1.8 s if never; then the frozen R0causal blend (blend_retract --tb 0.5 --w0 0.6 --tex 1.0 --tex-smooth 0.1) with T_r = T_r_hat instead of 1.4, safety_project --smooth 300
lane: dev only: 900 dev interruptions (interrupts_dev.json), inference seed 0 per_clip; R0causal_p (T_r 1.4) of the same model / protocol / continuation is the reference
